answer: Time-of-flight cell attestation: each agent answers nonces through a hardware radio to three independently operated UWB beacons; round-trip bounds under the speed of light map it to a geographic cell, with one active identity per radio fingerprint. A single operator cannot fake distant cells from one site. Sybil cost: real radios, beacon access, and maintained physical sites—e.g. a canyon rim, meadow, or ember-prone ridge—per identity cell.
